title: EdgeLoom capability map
description: Declares, per driver, which hidden device attributes EdgeLoom may surface and which capability each one binds to. This is the reviewable statement of what a patch run is allowed to expose; it supersedes the untyped INI pair (custom_capability_list.config, driver2patch.config).

version.description: Schema version this document targets, e.g. '0.1'.

platform.description: Target platform. The map is platform-scoped because capability namespaces are not portable across ecosystems.

drivers.description: Keyed by driver directory name, e.g. 'zigbee-lock'.

handler.description: Stem of the Lua handler injected into the driver's src/, e.g. 'lock_patch'.

subdriver.description: Subdriver template directory copied into the driver, e.g. 'lock-patch'.

attributes.description: Maps a device attribute name to the capability ID that exposes it.
